description: Source code for a subtitle alignment utility that realigns subtitle cues with a reference transcript, supporting advanced matching techniques including fuzzy matching and semantic embeddings. It provides a primary function `align_subtitles_to_transcript` which normalizes input, performs alignment, enforces non-overlap constraints, and outputs cleaned subtitle cues with improved timing accuracy.

methods.description: Main function that normalizes inputs, computes alignment with optional semantic and fuzzy matching, enforces timing constraints, and returns adjusted subtitle cues.
